# Snippets the exec-consent enumerator must classify. A checker that degraded
# into "return nothing" passes the real gate forever and reads as coverage, so
# it is made to prove it can still see — and to prove the verdict turns on the
# MARKER and its POSITION, never on which binary is being spawned.
#
# Each block is:
#   FLAG <name>   — the enumerator MUST report at least one finding
#   PASS <name>   — the enumerator MUST report none
# followed by one or more lines of Go, wrapped by the test into
#   func execConsentSnippet(ctx context.Context, pkg, dir, ref, host string) { … }
#
# The PASS rows are not only assertions: TestEverySpawnSiteGatedOrExempt
# materialises them into real source and sweeps that tree, so the repo-wide gate
# has a non-vacuous green corpus before t-10 widens it to internal/ and cmd/.
#
# The floor is derived: TestExecConsentFlagsItsOwnSnippets asserts it exercised
# every row it parsed, so a row cannot be deleted or skipped without failing.

# --- an unmarked spawn is a finding, whatever it spawns ---

FLAG unmarked-git-spawn
	exec.Command("git", "status", "--porcelain")

FLAG unmarked-unknown-binary
	exec.Command("cargo", "test", pkg)

FLAG unmarked-command-context
	exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "show", ref)

# --- marker grammar: prose is required, and it must say something ---

FLAG reasonless-marker
	//dross:exec-exempt
	exec.Command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD")

FLAG reason-is-only-the-subcommand
	//dross:exec-exempt status
	exec.Command("git", "status")

FLAG marker-glued-to-its-reason
	//dross:exec-exemptgit status reads the tree and runs no repo-authored code
	exec.Command("git", "status")

FLAG spaced-comment-is-not-a-directive
	// dross:exec-exempt git status reads the tree and runs no repo-authored code
	exec.Command("git", "status")

# --- position, not proximity ---

FLAG marker-two-lines-above
	//dross:exec-exempt git status reads the tree and runs no repo-authored code
	_ = dir
	exec.Command("git", "status")

FLAG marker-below-the-call
	exec.Command("git", "status")
	//dross:exec-exempt git status reads the tree and runs no repo-authored code

# --- the green corpus ---

PASS marked-with-prose
	//dross:exec-exempt git status reads the working tree; it runs no repo-authored code
	exec.Command("git", "status", "--porcelain")

PASS marked-command-context
	//dross:exec-exempt git show is plumbing over objects, never repo-authored code
	exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "show", ref)

PASS marked-unknown-binary
	//dross:exec-exempt the argv is fixed by dross; cargo reads no repo-authored line
	exec.Command("cargo", "--version")

PASS marker-with-tab-before-its-reason
	//dross:exec-exempt	rsync moves the tree and never executes a repo-authored line
	exec.Command("rsync", "-a", dir, host)

PASS not-a-spawn-at-all
	_ = host
